title: Nanoporous polymer-derived activated carbon for hydrogen adsorption and electrochemical energy storage
material_description: PDAC | polyaniline (PANi)-derived activated carbon powder: PANi hydrogel (aniline, phytic acid, ammonium persulfate) freeze-dried to an aerogel, carbonized under N2 and KOH-activated; made by Z. Bao and co-workers (ref. 29); ~95% of QSDFT surface area in pores <2 nm
activation_method: KOH (potassium hydroxide) chemical activation after carbonization of the freeze-dried PANi aerogel under N2; conditions in ref. 29, not given in this paper
source_location: main article PDF p.6, Fig. 3a, PDAC @ 77 K filled circles (adsorption), marker 2 of 34 in archive
notes: archive: HYC-0082_Fig3a_PDAC_77K_adsorption.json; marker 2, pixel_count 26. x read as 12.1951 mbar, converted to bar. wt% convention W2 (Table 3 footnote defines Cg as mass of adsorbed H2 per mass of adsorbed H2 plus degassed sample). Instrument, degassing (250 C, 12 h, 1e-6 mbar = 1e-4 Pa) and sample mass (~50 mg printed, stored as 50 mg) are stated in Sec. 2.2 for the Quantachrome Autosorb-1-MP Ar measurements; the paper records the low-pressure H2 isotherms "using the same system". He used for void volumes (Sec. 2.2). Characterization (Table 1, Ar at 87 K, QSDFT slit pores, degassed sample): S_DFT 2193 m2/g stored in bet_surface_area_m2_g as the headline total area with surface_area_method=DFT (no BET area is reported); V_DFT 0.995 cm3/g (pores <36 nm), V_DFT(MP) 0.944 cm3/g (<2 nm), S_DFT(MP) 2158 m2/g, d50 0.92 nm (volume-weighted median pore size, d25-d75 0.72-1.30 nm; average_pore_diameter_nm holds d50); SAXS-derived area 2360 m2/g and l_pore 1.69 nm not stored. Skeletal density ~2.15 g/cm3 (He pycnometry); poured bulk density ~0.45 g/cm3 stored as packing_density. N 0.5-2.3 wt% (XPS) is reported only for similar PANi-derived carbons in ref. 29, so no dopant is recorded.
basis_evidence: Table 3 title: "excess gravimetric and volumetric H2 storage capacities of the degassed PDAC and YP80F materials" (basis named, not defined)
free_volume_calibration: He for void volume calculations (temperature not stated)
